in_marathi.name: Charan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Footstep, path, journey
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chara’ which means ‘to move, to roam, or to go.’ This name is associated with the divine feet of the gods and signifies taking the first steps on a spiritual or physical journey. In Hindu mythology, the divine feet of gods are considered sacred and auspicious.
